name: Jungle Reese Bass
desc: Rolling detuned-sawtooth reese with a slow filter bloom — the classic jungle/dnb moving bass, sourced from the full_show jungle improv.

code.full: note("<a1 a1 [a1 g1] a1 g1 g1 [g1 a1] g1>/2").add(note(${root})).add(note("0,0.12")).s("sawtooth").lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.4, ${cut}*1.6).slow(16)).lpq(4).shape(${drive}).attack(.008).decay(.14).sustain(.5).release(.1).gain(${gain}).room(.14).every(8, x => x.ply(2)).orbit(3).play()
code.peak: note("<[a1 ~ a1 g1] [~ g1 ~ a1] [g1 ~ f1 ~] [~ e1 ~ a1]>").add(note(${root})).add(note("0,0.12,-0.12")).s("sawtooth").lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.5, ${cut}*2.2).slow(8)).lpq(6).shape(${drive}*1.2).attack(.005).decay(.1).sustain(.4).release(.08).gain(${gain}).room(.12).every(4, x => x.fast(2)).orbit(3).play()
